value_proposition: A fully customizable scheduling software for individuals, businesses taking calls and developers building scheduling platforms where users meet users.

observed_facts.fact: Cal.com offers a free plan that includes unlimited event types, calendar syncing, workflow automation, Stripe payments, and Cal Video.
observed_facts.evidence: Cal.com's free plan includes unlimited event types, calendar syncing, workflow automation, Stripe payments, and Cal Video, making it one of the most fully featured free scheduling tools on the market.

observed_facts.fact: The Teams plan is priced at $16 per user per month.
observed_facts.evidence: Teams ($16/user/month) adds round-robin scheduling, shared availability, and team workflows, making it ideal scheduling software for small business.

observed_facts.fact: The Organizations plan is priced at $37 per user per month.
observed_facts.evidence: Organizations ($37/user/month) include org-wide admin controls and centralized management for larger companies using Cal.com’s scheduler as their meeting scheduling software.

analytical_insights: Cal.com positions itself as a developer-friendly and fully customizable alternative to traditional scheduling tools like Calendly.
The product offers a multi-tiered pricing model targeting individuals up to enterprise organizations with strict security requirements.
